name: School in Rose Valley Summer Camp
description_short: Day camp on the School in Rose Valley's 9.5 acre wooded campus beside Ridley Creek for ages 3 to 15. Older campers choose their own activities each day, such as swimming, art, nature, drama, archery and woodshop, and younger groups explore the same activities in a set structure with daily swim lessons.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel six or more weeks before June 14 for a refund minus the $100 per week deposit; 50% refund three to six weeks before; no refund within three weeks of the start or during camp.
swim_waterfront_notes: Daily swim lessons led by certified lifeguards at the school's swimming complex.
notes: 2027: June 14 to August 13, closed Friday June 18 and Monday July 5 (those weeks discounted). Hours 8:20 am to 3:15 pm, staggered pickup to 3:45; preschool half days 8:20 to 11:45. Morning care from 7:45 ($5 a day per the FAQ) and after care to 6 pm. Programs: Seeds preschool (from 2 years 7 months), Sprouts (K to 1), Blossoms and Apples choice program (grades 2 to 7), CIT (grades 8 to 9, minimum four weeks). Week 9 is a pared down week without woodshop or archery. Children bring lunch; morning snack provided. Registration opens January 22, 2027. The Pricing page lists $515 a week ($440 for the two short weeks) and preschool and extended care rates, but it carries no year, so no price is recorded.
